import sqlite3, sys

db_path = '/workspace/app.db'

conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
conn.execute('PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL')
conn.close()

conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
cursor = conn.cursor()
cursor.execute('PRAGMA user_version')
version = cursor.fetchone()[0]
print(f'version: {version}')
assert version == 1, f'Expected 1, got {version}'

cursor.execute('SELECT id, email, full_name FROM users ORDER BY id')
users_raw = cursor.fetchall()
print(f'users: {len(users_raw)}')

cursor.execute('SELECT id, user_id, amount, created_at FROM orders')
orders_raw = cursor.fetchall()
print(f'orders: {len(orders_raw)}')
conn.close()

# Test parsing amounts
def parse_amount(text):
    s = text.strip()
    if not s: return None
    negative = False
    if s.startswith('(') and s.endswith(')'):
        s = s[1:-1]
        negative = True
    elif s.startswith('-'):
        s = s[1:]
        negative = True
    elif s.startswith('\$'):
        s = s[1:]
    elif s.startswith('(-'):
        s = s[2:-1]
        negative = True
    if not s: return None
    s = s.replace(',', '')
    try:
        value = float(s)
    except ValueError:
        return None
    if negative: value = -value
    cents = round(value * 100)
    return int(cents)

bad = []
for oid, uid, amt, created in orders_raw:
    cents = parse_amount(amt)
    if cents is None:
        bad.append((oid, uid, amt))
        print(f'BAD: oid={oid}, amt={repr(amt)}')

print(f'Bad orders: {len(bad)}')
" 2>&1

python3 -c "
import sqlite3

conn = sqlite3.connect('/tmp/test_edge.db')
conn.execute('PRAGMA user_version = 1')
conn.execute('CREATE TABLE users(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, email TEXT, full_name TEXT)')
conn.execute('CREATE TABLE orders(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER, amount TEXT, created_at TEXT)')

# Test name splitting
# One word: first='X', last=''
conn.execute('INSERT INTO users VALUES(1, \"a@b.com\", \"John\")')
# Empty: first='', last=''
conn.execute('INSERT INTO users VALUES(2, \"b@c.com\", \"\")')
# NULL: first='', last=''
conn.execute('INSERT INTO users VALUES(3, \"c@d.com\", NULL)')
# All whitespace: first='', last=''
conn.execute('INSERT INTO users VALUES(4, \"d@e.com\", \"   \")')
# Multiple words: first='A B', last='C'
conn.execute('INSERT INTO users VALUES(5, \"e@f.com\", \"  A  B   C  \")')
# Tab-separated: first='A', last='B'
conn.execute('INSERT INTO users VALUES(6, \"f@g.com\", \"A\tB\")')
# Single word with spaces around: first='X', last=''
conn.execute('INSERT INTO users VALUES(7, \"g@h.com\", \"  X  \")')

# Test amounts
# Normal
conn.execute('INSERT INTO orders VALUES(1, 1, \"12\", \"2026-01-01\")')
# Decimal
conn.execute('INSERT INTO orders VALUES(2, 1, \"12.5\", \"2026-01-01\")')
# Dollar sign
conn.execute('INSERT INTO orders VALUES(3, 1, \"\$1,234.50\", \"2026-01-01\")')
# Negative
conn.execute('INSERT INTO orders VALUES(4, 1, \"-12.50\", \"2026-01-01\")')
conn.execute('INSERT INTO orders VALUES(5, 1, \"-\$12.50\", \"2026-01-01\")')
conn.execute('INSERT INTO orders VALUES(6, 1, \"(12.50)\", \"2026-01-01\")')
conn.execute('INSERT INTO orders VALUES(7, 1, \"(\$12.50)\", \"2026-01-01\")')
# Padding
conn.execute('INSERT INTO orders VALUES(8, 1, \" 7.05 \", \"2026-01-01\")')
# Negative with comma
conn.execute('INSERT INTO orders VALUES(9, 1, \"-\$1,234.56\", \"2026-01-01\")')

# Order with non-existent user
conn.execute('INSERT INTO orders VALUES(10, 999, \"100\", \"2026-01-01\")')

# Duplicate email
conn.execute('INSERT INTO users VALUES(10, \"a@b.com\", \"Different Name\")')
conn.execute('INSERT INTO orders VALUES(11, 10, \"200\", \"2026-01-01\")')

# Blank email
conn.execute('INSERT INTO users VALUES(11, \"  \", \"Blank Email\")')
conn.execute('INSERT INTO orders VALUES(12, 11, \"300\", \"2026-01-01\")')

conn.commit()
conn.close()
print('Done')
"
